{{Quote|The Empire is sending one of their best fighter pilots to this location. His orders are simple: terminate our fleet.|[[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] [[Aqzow]], about Kroger|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Kroger''' was a [[TIE pilot|pilot]] who served as a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was considered a strategic genius when it came to [[Navy/Legends|naval]] warfare, and an excellent [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] [[Aqzow]] of [[Havoc Squadron]] tasked a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Major Kroger before he could reach the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. To that end, the pilot loyal to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] located Kroger in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]] piloting an experimental [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] alongside an escort of two [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]]. The Havoc Squadron pilot engaged the Imperials and destroyed them successfully.<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kroger appeared aboard his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
